entries.scope: Cross-repository documentation boundary between Home Baseline and the sandbox image
entries.rationale: Learners and maintainers need one consistent distinction between Home-owned learning and source/runtime guidance, image-owned build and mount behavior, the exact embedded lock state, the current upstream documentation, and the image's smaller three-series mount scope.
readerPaths: Home Baseline source and runtime boundary
entries.canonicalSource: Home Baseline for learner, Git-hosting, governance, and source/runtime guidance; this repository for image build, tool versions, mounts, commands, and the installed runtime wrapper
entries.navigationImpact: Learner and operations paths now link to the canonical Home Baseline architecture while retaining the exact image lock as the offline source of truth.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in synchronized sections at approximately CEFR B2.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: A deterministic repository contract test checks audience, toolchain classification, current-versus-pinned wording, canonical links, and the exact three-series Compose mount subset. Compose configuration is validated separately on the available macOS host.
entries.risk: Medium; an unclear ownership or version boundary can make learners follow newer upstream instructions against an older embedded image or mistake the image's mount subset for the complete Home Baseline catalog.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: The Home Baseline lock, learner audience, required MSL paths, project mounts, runtime wrapper, or cross-repository ownership changes.
